transcript: Speaker A: English mein haarne ke ye paanch lakshan kabhi mat karna. Pehla, bina taiyaari ke interview mat do... [Never do these five things that show you are losing in English. First, don't go to interviews unprepared. Second, don't memorize complex vocabulary; speak simply. Third, stop copying generic 'Tell me about yourself' answers. Fourth, don't prepare at the last minute. Fifth, stop just listening and start speaking. If you have these habits, you will face rejection. Download the English Seekho app for a 1-rupee trial. It offers expert courses in Hindi and a 24/7 AI coach to practice speaking without judgment. Stop making these mistakes and start practicing today for your next job.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho INSTALL NOW [Disclaimer text explaining that the app is not affiliated with any government authority and results depend on individual effort.]
summary: The advertisement highlights five critical mistakes candidates make during English job interviews, warning that these habits lead to constant rejection. It introduces the English Seekho app as a solution, featuring a 1-rupee trial, practical courses, and a 24/7 AI speaking coach. The call to action urges users to install the app to improve their communication skills and secure their next job.
